phrases.latin: Vidulum mandābimus; sarcinulam manuālem nōbīscum in āëroplanum portābimus.
phrases.english: We’ll check in the suitcase; we’ll take the hand luggage with us onto the plane.

phrases.latin: Licetne hanc sarcinulam manuālem mēcum in āëroplanum portāre?
phrases.english: May I take this hand luggage with me on the plane?

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 213, 215, 289.
